# Adding Images and Alt-Text in MarginNote (2024-11-29 11:47:22)

_**User**_

how do I add the image in the margin note? I also want alt-text

---

_**Assistant**_

I'll help you modify the MarginNote in your index.mdx file to include an image with alt-text. In Astro/MDX, you can include images in a MarginNote component using standard markdown image syntax or HTML img tags.

Here's how to update your index.mdx:

```mdx:src/pages/index.mdx
// Previous content...
<MarginNote>How Meaning is made. You can porabbly raed tihs ptetry wlel eevn tohguh it's all jubemld up. But have you seen it yet? 

![A visual demonstration of how the brain processes jumbled text](/images/jumbled-text.jpg "Jumbled text example")
</MarginNote>
// Rest of the content...
```

Or alternatively, using an HTML img tag for more control:

```mdx:src/pages/index.mdx
// Previous content...
<MarginNote>How Meaning is made. You can porabbly raed tihs ptetry wlel eevn tohguh it's all jubemld up. But have you seen it yet? 

<img 
  src="/images/jumbled-text.jpg" 
  alt="A visual demonstration of how the brain processes jumbled text" 
  title="Jumbled text example"
/>
</MarginNote>
// Rest of the content...
```

A few important notes:
1. Make sure to place your image in the `public/images/` directory of your Astro project
2. Leave a blank line between the text and the image in the MarginNote for proper markdown parsing
3. The image path should start with a forward slash as shown above
4. The alt-text is provided in square brackets with markdown syntax, or in the `alt` attribute with HTML syntax
5. You can optionally add a title (shown on hover) using quotes in markdown or the `title` attribute in HTML

Choose the image path and alt-text that best describes your actual image. If you haven't created the images directory yet, you'll need to create it in your public folder and add your image there.

I've added two properties to the `.sidenote, .margin-note` CSS rule:
1. `text-align: justify` - This will justify the text in the margin notes
2. `hyphens: auto` - This enables automatic hyphenation which helps with justified text to avoid large gaps between words

The changes will apply to both desktop and mobile views of your margin notes. The text should now be more evenly distributed across the width of the margin note.
